Container.Name: botmem
Container.Overview: Personal memory system that ingests events from multiple data sources (emails, messages, photos, locations), normalizes them into a unified memory schema, and provides cross-modal retrieval with weighted ranking. Local-first, privacy-focused: your data stays on your server.[br][br]Requires PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector and Redis 7. The companion compose in the Botmem repo exposes PostgreSQL on host port 15432 and Redis on host port 16379, which match this template's defaults.[br][br]AI processing can use local Ollama, Google Gemini, or OpenRouter. Ollama is optional if you configure a cloud backend instead.[br][br][b]Quick start:[/b] Start the companion dependency stack or point DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL at your existing services, choose an AI backend, generate the required secrets, then open the WebUI and create your first local user. Queue workers run inside the Botmem container for self-hosted installs.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: memory rag personal ai search email messages photos recall knowledge base vector
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL 16+ with pgvector, Redis 7+. Install these from Community Applications first, or use unraid/docker-compose.unraid.yml from the Botmem repo.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Botmem web interface and API port.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent data directory for connector session files, logs, and caches. Must be writable by container uid 1000.

Config.Name: Plugins Directory
Config.Description: External plugin directory (optional). Mounted read-only and enabled by PLUGINS_DIR=/plugins. Must be readable by container uid 1000.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection string. Default matches the companion stack host port 15432.

Config.Name: Redis URL
Config.Description: Redis connection string for BullMQ job queues. Default matches the companion stack host port 16379.

Config.Name: App Secret
Config.Description: AES-256-GCM encryption key for credentials at rest. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48

Config.Name: JWT Access Secret
Config.Description: Secret for signing JWT access tokens. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48

Config.Name: JWT Refresh Secret
Config.Description: Secret for signing JWT refresh tokens. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48

Config.Name: OAuth State Secret
Config.Description: Secret for connector OAuth state tokens. Required in production. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48

Config.Name: Encryption Salt
Config.Description: Deployment-specific salt for encrypted credentials and memories. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

Config.Name: Auth Provider
Config.Description: Authentication mode. Use local for self-hosted Unraid installs.

Config.Name: Enable API Workers
Config.Description: Run sync and memory queue workers inside the Botmem API container. Keep true for self-hosted installs so connectors such as iMessage can share the API websocket tunnel.

Config.Name: AI Backend
Config.Description: AI inference backend: 'ollama' (local/remote), 'gemini' (Google API), or 'openrouter' (cloud API).

Config.Name: Embedding Backend
Config.Description: Optional embedding backend override. Leave empty to follow AI_BACKEND. Supported: ollama, gemini, openrouter.

Config.Name: Ollama Base URL
Config.Description: Ollama inference endpoint. Only needed when AI_BACKEND=ollama or EMBED_BACKEND=ollama.

Config.Name: Ollama Username
Config.Description: Basic auth username for Ollama (optional, for remote Ollama behind auth proxy).

Config.Name: Ollama Password
Config.Description: Basic auth password for Ollama (optional).

Config.Name: Ollama Embedding Model
Config.Description: Ollama model for generating embeddings (1024d). Must be pulled in Ollama first.

Config.Name: Ollama Text Model
Config.Description: Ollama model for text enrichment (entity extraction, claims, factuality).

Config.Name: Ollama Vision Model
Config.Description: Ollama vision-language model for photo/image analysis.

Config.Name: OpenRouter API Key
Config.Description: API key for OpenRouter (required if AI_BACKEND=openrouter).

Config.Name: OpenRouter Embedding Model
Config.Description: OpenRouter embedding model.

Config.Name: OpenRouter Text Model
Config.Description: OpenRouter text enrichment model.

Config.Name: OpenRouter Vision Model
Config.Description: OpenRouter vision-language model for media parsing.

Config.Name: Gemini API Key
Config.Description: Google Gemini API key. Required if AI_BACKEND=gemini or EMBED_BACKEND=gemini.

Config.Name: Gemini Embedding Model
Config.Description: Gemini embedding model.

Config.Name: Gemini Media Model
Config.Description: Gemini model used for image/document/audio media parsing.

Config.Name: Gemini Embedding Dimensions
Config.Description: Output dimensions for Gemini embeddings.

Config.Name: Frontend URL
Config.Description: Public URL for CORS and OAuth redirects. Set to your Unraid IP:port or reverse proxy URL.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Public API/base URL used in connector OAuth callbacks and CLI login links.

Config.Name: Plugins Directory Env
Config.Description: Container path for external plugins. Matches the Plugins Directory path mapping.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Internal API port (should match WebUI port mapping).
